userdoc.notice: This contract is designed as a SENDER-ONLY contract This contract sends staking/unstaking messages to the MetUserState contract via LayerZero and does NOT receive messages itself ARCHITECTURE: - TokenStaking (this contract) sends messages -> MetUserState contract receives - All cross-chain state updates happen on the MetUserState receiver side - Each chain has its own TokenStaking instance that sends to MetUserState - The receiver-side implementation is in MetUserState.sol DEPLOYMENT & MONITORING REQUIREMENTS: 1. MetUserState must be deployed and configured as the receiver before this contract 2. Set proper LayerZero destination endpoint IDs for MetUserState 3. Monitor LayerZero message delivery success/failure on MetUserState side 4. Monitor failed deliveries and implement retry mechanisms in backend 5. Monitor gas costs and LayerZero fee changes across chains 6. Ensure MetUserState has proper access controls for receiving messages
